title: Twenty thousand nested flow sequences give exactly the events, or a limit error, within bounds
notes: The input is valid YAML. A library that reads it must give exactly the expected events; one that refuses it must say so with a limit error. A crash, a hang, a wrong result, or more than the stated time or memory fails. The input and its events come from the specification; the resource bounds are the robustness requirement of the kit, not a rule of the specification.
